# chalk_aws_cloud_credentials (Data Source)

Reads a Chalk AWS cloud credentials object by ID. Returns the identifying account/region/role fields; deliberately omits docker_build_config and gcp_workload_identity (use the resource block if you need those nested configs).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cloud credentials identifier.

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) AWS account ID.
- `aws_external_id` (String) AWS external ID used for STS role assumption (commonly the team ID).
- `aws_management_role_arn` (String) AWS management role ARN that Chalk assumes into the account.
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region.
- `name` (String) Cloud credentials display name.
